sharedPatchRequests.change: Consume the WP-01 authenticated authority context with principal, bound device/credential and explicit shared versus standalone mode; resource authorization remains server-derived. Expose negotiated device capabilities and durable resume results through typed domain ports without treating capability strings or webContentsId as grants. Do not bypass the existing localElectron gate.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Current three-field context cannot deny forged actor/workspace, check revoke fences or bind a resume cursor to a principal.

sharedPatchRequests.symbol: WsRpcServerOptions.validateToken / validateSessionCookie / ClientConnection / onConnection / onRequest / push / registeredChannelsFor
sharedPatchRequests.change: Use accepted foundation principal resolvers instead of interpreting a boolean auth result as actor identity. Bind resume to principal+device+workspace+credential/policy epoch, compare those on reconnect, refresh capabilities from the new validated advertisement (current reconnect reuses the old Set), and reauthorize resource events before live delivery or buffered replay. Domain.device.resume invokes the durable gateway after handshake; retain transport seq/ring replay only as acceleration. Do not replay revoked raw buffers or ACK domain projection progress merely because bytes were sent. Preserve trusted Electron-main proof and localElectron channel filtering.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Current reconnect compares workspace/webContents/local proof but not actor/device; buffers and workspace broadcast lack current resource checks, and capabilities can remain stale after reconnect.

sharedPatchRequests.change: Register domain.device.resume through the accepted typed domain command port. Keep command:list/approve/deny's pending-owner workflow separate from shared transaction receipts; do not use decide(...,'owner') for device resume. Add typed capability/resume/deep-link query adapters only after their contracts are accepted.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Existing gateway is phase-0 pending-command review, not the authoritative v2 mutation gateway.

sharedPatchRequests.change: Keep the six local Electron action constants and wrappers. sharedPatchRequests.symbol: WsRpcClient.onMessage / onDisconnect / onConnectionStateChanged / emitReconnected / handleCapability / isChannelAvailable
sharedPatchRequests.change: Reuse lazy connect, backoff, connection generation and existing reconnected notification. Bind the accepted durable resume adapter at handshake/reconnect and gap detection; keep transport connected distinct from domain synchronized. On sequence gap signal stale/recovery rather than only warning and advancing a domain watermark. Persist domain cursor only after projection transaction via WP-05. Advertise only supported registered handlers; missing legacy channel advertisements must not imply new domain/media capability. Do not retry mutations blindly after Connection lost; reconcile the original idempotent command receipt first.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Current event branch warns then advances seq and invokes listeners, requests are rejected on disconnect, and connected means handshake complete rather than projection verified.

sharedPatchRequests.change: Add typed device.resume/GetDeviceCapabilities/ResumeSync/OpenDeepLink facade methods using accepted shared schemas mapped to Swift Codable DTOs in the existing protocol layer; route through transport.request and enforce canonical scoped ref/receipt decoding. Resume may not use callVoid, because dropping status/receipt permits false success. Preserve independent domain versus transport readiness and expose rejection/unavailable states to existing ViewModels.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Facade currently has generic calls only; no typed resume/result/capability contract.

sharedPatchRequests.change: In .response first reject envelope.error as TransportError.remote before considering result/null; preserve legitimate null successes only when error is absent. Consume reconnected/stale ACK fields, reset transport seq on fresh connection, trigger authorized durable resume/full refresh before domain-ready, and handle gaps/duplicates via the accepted projection adapter. Keep empty Electron capabilities on iOS unless a real supported handler exists. Scope retained clientId/lastSeenSeq to current principal/workspace/device, clearing stale reconnect identity on explicit target/account switch; maintain existing Task cancellation and socket identity guards.
sharedPatchRequests.reason: Server sendResponseError sends type=response with error. Swift currently resolves such envelopes as null, while callVoid discards it. ACK's stale/reconnected fields are ignored and reconnect state survives workspace changes.

risks: Transport-only changes cannot satisfy actual reduced-motion/focus/font/touch/media UX; published affectedFiles do not contain rendering components.
Boolean handshake authentication and client-declared workspace are not transport-derived actor authorization; replay must bind principal/device/credential and current policy.
Swift RPCTransport.handle(.response) resolves error envelopes as null; callVoid can appear successful without domain action. This is static code evidence, not a reproduced runtime failure.

Swift ignores stale/reconnected ACK and retains seq/clientId across explicit target/workspace changes; TS treats fresh reconnect as stale but marks transport connected before durable domain projection readiness.
Current reconnect retains the old capability Set, which can advertise actions absent on the reconnecting platform; Electron action advertisement is untrusted support metadata, never a security grant.

Workspace/all push buffers can retain private payload after revoke; replay must reauthorize or invalidate them, and domain event delivery uses durable outbox/current policy rather than raw in-memory buffers.
Client event sequence gaps currently only warn; treating transport lastSeq as durable projection cursor risks acknowledging dropped events and stale content.
Three normative new files are shared across foundation packages; WP-46 must request additive contributions, not create competing stores or overwrite integration work.
projection_cursor may already exist when predecessors land; generating a second table or migration constraint copy would create a competing cursor authority.

Normative domain integer version versus wire string, device_session kind naming, first-resume required cursor and result enum-versus-triad/receipt invariants require accepted contracts rather than silent coercion.

WP-41 is a broad integrated gate and COLLAB-01 lists WP-46 among scenario packages. Lead must stage baseline producer acceptance separately from final WP-46-integrated rerun; do not remove the explicit edge or claim final cross-device scenario before WP-46 exists.
Search/mentions/notifications/sharing/agent completeness cannot become N/A simply because this package exposes transport seams; require producer interfaces and cross-device regressions.

No shared reusable service credential may be stored in renderer. Bearer/session credentials require the accepted secure credential/device contract; ephemeral localClientProof must remain local and never become remote identity.

Whole-file hashes are working-tree snapshots while root wave0 work is uncommitted; input HEAD is lineage only. Any verifier mismatch means stale evidence requiring scoped refresh, not a reason to edit source or conceal drift.
All live scenarios, package tests, schema/migration execution and UI evidence remain unperformed in this preflight. featureComplete is false.
